info.name: Foundational Time Series Model Multi Series

items.docs: Based on the provided data, this endpoint predicts the future values of multiple time series at once. It takes a JSON as an input containing information like the series frequency and historical data. (See below for a full description of the parameters.) The response contains the predicted values for each series based on the input arguments. Get your token at https://nixtla.io/free-trial?utm_source=nixtla.io&utm_campaign=/docs/api-reference.
